content_of_post_to_comment:
Good afternoon, family.

Thank you for all the uplifting comments. They mean more than you know. I wasn't going to address this but a person made a comment saying.

" Bro stop posting your sober we get it already."

I'll share why I post every day. It's therapy for me, and I hope it lifts someone who's having a rough time. If it helps even one person, I did my job. My grandma taught me that if you don't have anything good to say, don't say anything at all, and I try to live by that, including with myself.

I know not everyone will like it, and that's okay. One negative comment someone made won't drown out the hundreds of kind ones. If I've ever said anything that brought someone down, I truly apologize.

I'll keep sharing, and I'll keep spreading the love regardless of one negative comment.

Thank you to everyone who gives me the strength to keep going.

If today is a hard one, you're not alone.

What's one thing that lifted you up this week?

One Day Forward One Day Behind -Shawn
comment: I like that you mentioned posting is part of your own therapy. People sometimes forget that sharing progress isn't always about getting recognition; sometimes putting your thoughts out there is part of staying accountable. And sobriety isn't a one-time achievement. Every day still counts, even if some people are tired of hearing about it.
